items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah I’d write them out, Al would write stuff out... I can’t remember if Al wrote anything or not, but he was sure in the band.

ctx.x: Are they things that you wrote out for him originally?
Yeah I’d write them out, Al would write stuff out, everybody’d write stuff out.
There was what, “Pot Luck,” was another one?
